name: manyfold
description: Manyfold(https://github.com/manyfold3d/manyfold/) is an open source, self-hosted web application for managing a collection of 3D models, particularly focused on 3D printing.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent storage for application configuration data.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Database connection URL. For sqlite use `sqlite3:/config/manyfold.sqlite3`. For postgres or mariadb use `scheme://username:password@hostname:port/db name` where `scheme` is `postgresql` or `mysql2`. Special characters in username/password must be URL encoded(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Percent-encoding).

variables.name: REDIS_URL
variables.description: Redis/Valkey database URL in `redis://hostname:port/db number` format.

variables.name: SECRET_KEY_BASE
variables.description: Browser session and database encryption key. If unset a random one will be generated on init, the database is locked to this key.
